name: 이회창
decision_basis: API end is impossible (seat count exceeds 299 from 1997-12-20, when the API seats his successor 이찬진). kowiki list and 의석 변동 both give 1997-11-26, the candidate registration day announced in advance.
source_1: Hankook Ilbo 1997-11-15 (text: 의원직사퇴 시기는 후보등록일인 오는 26일이 될것)
note: Weak. The news item reports a plan, not the effective date. Hankook 1998-05-06 says 이찬진 took the seat in December 1997, so the resignation may have taken effect later than 11-26 but no later than 1997-12-20.
